changelog: Queue lock efficiency: the bundled engine's version is resolved once per binary instead of being spawned for every queued task, the settings file is no longer stat-ed for every queued task (484 storage probes for 27 tasks became 10), the extraction cache is not re-read for every job on every planning pass, and no log line or filesystem call is made while the queue lock is held
description: Synchronize subtitles with video audio using ffsubsync
name: SubSync
overview: Adds a Sync Subtitles action to any video, using ffsubsync as backend
